    BO13a Lemma 7: the core #

    • RayCat.depth_add_le, RayCat.one_le_depth, RayCat.isIrreducible_of_depth, RayCat.depth_lt_of_le: depth estimates.
    • MulBasis.no_crown_irr: a crown of irreducible morphisms contradicts the existence of a long morphism.
    • MulBasis.l7_nice: the contour of σ carrying ρ is α e₁ e₂ with ρ = α ≫ ρ' and ρ ∤ α e₁.
    • MulBasis.l7_depth: depth σ ≤ 4.
